CHAPTER 01 // ORIGIN & FINAL SELECTION 01/03

Cruelty in the Snow & The Pitch-Black Katana

Returning from selling charcoal at the foot of Mount Kumotori, Tanjiro Kamado finds his family slaughtered by Muzan Kibutsuji and his sister Nezuko transformed into a demon who still weeps to protect him. Spared by Water Hashira Giyu Tomioka, Tanjiro trains under Sakonji Urokodaki on Mount Sagiri for two years, mastering the ten forms of Water Breathing (水の呼吸).

CHAPTER 02 // MOUNT NATAGUMO AWAKENING 02/03

Episode 19: Hinokami Kagura & Exploding Blood

Cornered by Lower Rank Five Rui in the spider-haunted woods of Mount Natagumo, Tanjiro's Nichirin sword snaps against crimson blood-webs. In a flash of life-or-death memory, he recalls his frail father Tanjuro dancing barefoot in the freezing snow with unending breath. Switching mid-stride from flowing water to solar fire, Tanjiro unleashes Hinokami Kagura: Dance (ヒノカミ神楽・円舞) fused with Nezuko's Blood Demon Art: Exploding Blood (爆血).

TRANSITION VECTOR: Tenth Form Constant Flux (拾ノ型・生生流転) ➔ Hinokami Kagura Solar Dragon
CHAPTER 03 // INTERACTIVE PHYSIOLOGY LAB 03/03

Unlocking the Demon Slayer Mark & Crimson Blade

At the Butterfly Mansion, Shinobu Kocho's trainees teach Tanjiro, Zenitsu, and Inosuke Total Concentration: Constant (全集中・常中)—maintaining full lung expansion 24 hours a day until massive gourd vessels shatter from breath pressure alone. Push the heart rate above 200 BPM and core body temperature above 39.0°C in the live stage simulator to awaken the Demon Slayer Mark (痣) and turn the Nichirin blade bright crimson!

ACT IV // YOSHIWARA (遊郭編)
04 譜面完成

Musical Score Completed & Godspeed Lightning

In the neon-lit labyrinth of Yoshiwara, Upper Rank Six splits into two bodies: Daki and her venomous brother Gyutaro—who can only be slain if both heads are severed simultaneously. With one hand severed and his heart stopped by poison, Sound Hashira Tengen Uzui completes his Musical Score Technique (譜面), reading Gyutaro's attacks as sheet music while Zenitsu's Thunderclap and Flash: Godspeed streaks across the burning sky.

ACT V // SWORDSMITH & HASHIRA TRAINING
05 赫刀と太陽克服

The Yoriichi Type Zero, Mist & Conquering the Sun

Inside the hidden village of steelmakers, Hotaru Haganezuka polishes the 300-year-old ancestral blade discovered inside the six-armed Yoriichi Type Zero automaton. Mist Hashira Muichiro Tokito and Love Hashira Mitsuri Kanroji manifest their Demon Slayer Marks against Upper Four Hantengu and Upper Five Gyokko. At daybreak, Nezuko kicks Tanjiro toward the fleeing demon—and stands unburned in the morning sun, triggering the final Hashira Training mobilization.
